It runs on this device with Gemini Nano through Android\'s AICore. Kotomo sends your text nowhere. Devices without Gemini Nano keep every typing feature.

Proofreading and rewriting work in English and Japanese; Chinese is not supported. Translation covers Chinese too.

Translate (on the toolbar) translates between Chinese, English and Japanese on this device with ML Kit. Its language models are downloaded from Google only when you tap Download; Chinese comes out in Simplified characters, and Chinese ↔ Japanese goes through English.
